name: inspection-record
title: Inspection record
for_each: select i.id, i.code from inspections i where i.inspected_on is not null order by i.code

sections.title: Inspection
sections.sql: select i.code, a.code job, a.site_address, a.approval_type, a.building_class, a.jurisdiction, i.stage, i.inspected_on, i.result, ce.name inspector, ce.registration_no, i.evidence_ref from inspections i join applications a on a.id = i.application_id left join certifiers ce on ce.id = i.inspector_id where i.id = $1

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select findings from inspections where id = $1

sections.title: Stages on this job
sections.sql: select s.stage, s.passed_on, s.booked_for from stage_status s join inspections i on i.application_id = s.application_id where i.id = $1 order by s.sequence

name: fee-proposal
title: Fee proposal
for_each: select q.id, q.code from quotes q where q.status = 'sent' order by q.code

sections.title: Proposal
sections.sql: select q.code, cl.name client, q.site_address, q.jurisdiction, q.approval_type, q.building_class, q.description, q.sent_on from quotes q join clients cl on cl.id = q.client_id where q.id = $1

sections.title: Fee
sections.sql: select 'Assessment, approval and ' || inspections_included || ' inspection(s)' item, fee_cents from quotes where id = $1
sections.note: Fees exclude GST unless stated. Additional or repeat inspections are quoted separately.

name: job-file
title: Job file summary
for_each: select id, code from applications where status <> 'withdrawn' order by code

sections.title: Job
sections.sql: select code, jurisdiction, approval_type, class, site_address, client, council, certifier, status, received_on, decided_on, council_lodged_on, final_issued_on from job_register where id = $1

sections.title: Required stages
sections.sql: select stage, passed_on, booked_for, failed_attempts from stage_status where application_id = $1 order by sequence

sections.title: Inspections
sections.sql: select code, stage, booked_for, result, inspected_on, findings from inspections where application_id = $1 order by booked_for

sections.title: Information requests
sections.sql: select code, request, sent_on, due_on, received_on from info_requests where application_id = $1 order by sent_on

sections.title: Rule findings
sections.sql: select c.rule, c.finding from record_checks c join applications a on a.code = c.code where a.id = $1
